text:
```yaml
name: ADR Review

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  adr-validation:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v2
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install copilot-cli

      - name: Run ADR validation
        run: |
          copilot generate --agent adr-generator --output docs/adr/new_adr.md

      - name: Check if new ADR was generated
        id: check_adr
        run: |
          if [ -f "docs/adr/new_adr.md" ]; then
            echo "::set-output name=has_adr::true"
          else
            echo "::set-output name=has_adr::false"
          fi

      - name: Commit and push new ADR if generated
        if: ${{ steps.check_adr.outputs.has_adr == 'true' }}
        run: |
          git config --global user.name 'GitHub Actions'
          git config --global user.email 'actions@github.com'
          git add docs/adr/new_adr.md
          git commit -m "Add new ADR based on PR #472"
          git push origin main

      - name: Create pull request if new ADR was generated
        if: ${{ steps.check_adr.outputs.has_adr == 'true' }}
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v3
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          title: "New ADR based on PR #472"
          body: "This ADR was automatically generated based on changes in PR #472."
          base: main
          head: main
```
